event.text:
Navbar visibility is restored for Sketchpad design app by fixing the shared navbar CSS selectors in `elements/ui/globals.css`.

### What changed
- Updated navbar rules to target all relevant selectors instead of only `#navbar`:
  - `#navbar`
  - `#compose\.sketchpad\.navbar`
  - `[data-slot="navbar"]`
- Applied this to:
  - base navbar stacking/pointer behavior
  - interactive child controls
  - drag-region behavior
  - fullscreen hide/show/hover behavior

This addresses the regression where Sketchpad uses `id="compose.sketchpad.navbar"` while the CSS was only styling `#navbar`, which can make navbar behavior inconsistent or appear missing in specific app views like design.

### Notes
- I attempted a lint diagnostics check, but the lints tool timed out twice for this file in the current session.
- If you want, I can run a quick Sketchpad smoke test next (open design route and verify navbar presence/interactivity).

event.text:
You’re right — there was still a fullscreen-driven hide path affecting the same area.

I patched `elements/ui/globals.css` again so fullscreen no longer auto-hides the top/bottom chrome:

- `.fullscreen` navbar now stays visible (`transform: translateY(0)`, no transition hide)
- `.fullscreen` footer now stays visible as well
- This removes the persistent “looks missing” behavior when fullscreen state is on in sketchpad/design

Please hard refresh the app (or restart the sketchpad dev view) and check design again.

If toolbar is still missing after refresh, I’ll patch the design toolbar render path next (specifically `toolbarSections.length` fallback in `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx`) so it never collapses silently.
